title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 3: Blue Emperor
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ３ ～ブルー・エンペラー～
overview:
The AQUAZONE world expands even further with new fish, water plants, accessories and background images!

This is the third option disc for Aquazone, the tropical fish tank simulator. It brings the blue emperor to raise in your virtual aquarium, along with new plants, ornaments and scenery for the tank.

- New fish: blue emperor
- New water plant: rotala
- New accessories: the Kumo no Shizuku sphere, an Akaigareishigai sea shell, the Pasamonte rock and a model of the Golden Pavilion (Kinkakuji)
- Six new background images
- Requires the Aquazone Sega Saturn disc

新しい魚、水草、アクセサリー、背景画によってさらに拡がるAQUAZONEワールド!
